Returns a list of all users and their information.

params.name: user_email
params.description: User's Email required for type=single. Used just to get one specific user. (Optional)

params.name: keyword
params.description: Keyword to filter the search by user's name or email. Can be used with either type=all, type=in_active, type=active to further filter users. (Optional)

params.name: type
params.description: Type of Report. Can be [all, active, in_active, single]. If type=single, requires user_email parameter. This parameter is required if using other filters. (Optional)

params.name: phish_start
params.description: Filter users by their next scheduled phishing simulation starting at this date. Can be used with all types except type=single. Requires a type parameter. (Users without scheduled phishing simulations will be excluded) - mm/dd/yyyy (Optional)

params.name: phish_end
params.description: Filter users by their next scheduled phishing simulation ending at this date. Can be used with all types except type=single. Requires a type parameter. (Users without scheduled phishing simulations will be excluded)- mm/dd/yyyy (Optional)

params.name: last_sim_passed
params.description: Filter users by their most recent phishing simulation. It will return users that have either passed (True) or failed (False) their recent simulation. Requires a type parameter. (Users without phsing simulations will default to passed.) (Optional)

params.name: department
params.description: Filter users by their department given by Outlook and Gmail group sync. Will not work for Open email types. Requires a type parameter. (Optional)

params.name: PageSize
params.description: Number of results to return. Defaults to 50 users per page. (Optional)

items.docs: Get a page of users based on given filters. Tip: Best to use type=all along with any other filters to narrow down your search.
Retrieves the SMS status for a user. Determines whether the user can be enrolled in a smishing simulation.

params.name: Limit
params.description: Max limit of vulnerability score to be viewed (Optional)

params.name: Bound
params.description: Bound of vulnerability score - can be upper or lower. ie. Having bound=upper and vul=60 returns a list contain users with 60 or less vulnerability score (Required)

items.docs: Retrieves users based on vulnerability score and bound, up to a limit.
